news.headline: Equities Analysts Issue Forecasts for uniQure Q3 Earnings
news.summary: HC Wainwright trimmed its Q3 2026 EPS loss estimate for uniQure to -$0.90 from -$0.84 while maintaining its Buy rating and $80 price target, the highest among covering analysts. The revision reflects expectations of continued heavy spend as uniQure ramps commercial-readiness and regulatory-filing activities for AMT-130.

news.headline: AdCom Expected for uniQure's Huntington's Gene Therapy, Chief Medical Officer Says
news.summary: uniQure CMO Walid Abi-Saab said the company expects and is preparing for an FDA advisory committee meeting on AMT-130, calling it welcome given the therapy would be the first approved treatment for Huntington's disease. The comments came as heightened FDA adcomm scrutiny across the rare-disease sector (including Capricor and Replimune) has raised investor sensitivity to potential panel reviews.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo lifted its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60 and reiterated an Overweight rating following the company's Q2 2026 results and FDA alignment update. The increase makes Wells Fargo one of the more bullish major banks covering the stock.

news.headline: Barclays Maintains uniQure (QURE) Rating, Lowers Price Target
news.summary: Barclays kept its Overweight/Buy rating on uniQure but trimmed its price target to $60 from $65 after Q2 2026 results showed a wider-than-expected non-GAAP loss driven by warrant valuation and FX charges. The bank remains constructive on the AMT-130 regulatory path despite the near-term earnings miss.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Announces $65 Price Target
news.summary: Wolfe Research analyst Rudy Li upgraded uniQure from Peer Perform to Outperform with a $65 price target, arguing the market is under-pricing AMT-130's approval odds at under 50% versus Wolfe's own 70% probability-of-success estimate. The upgrade cited a "clear path to approval" for the Huntington's disease gene therapy after the FDA's accelerated-approval alignment.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.84 million (beating estimates) but a wider non-GAAP net loss of $1.22 per share, while confirming that official FDA meeting minutes verified alignment on using 3-year Phase I/II data as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, targeted for Q3 2026 submission. The company also disclosed $810.3 million in cash following a recent $259 million capital raise, extending its runway into 2030.

catalysts.label: US BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the accelerated approval pathway, based on 3-year Phase I/II data, and intends to request priority review.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA MAA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: In parallel with the US filing, uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130, following a positive pre-submission meeting.

catalysts.label: 4-year AMT-130 follow-up data
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present longer-term follow-up data (including four-year results for early cohorts) from the ongoing Phase I/II studies of AMT-130 at a Huntington's disease scientific conference.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory trial design finalization
catalysts.detail: uniQure and the FDA are aligning on a randomized, concurrent standard-of-care control design (rather than sham surgery) with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint for the required post-approval confirmatory study.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA advisory committee meeting
catalysts.detail: Management expects and is preparing for an FDA advisory committee (adcomm) review of AMT-130's data package, though the FDA has not yet formally scheduled one.

catalysts.label: Epilepsy and Fabry program updates
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to clinical updates for the AMT-260 (refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy) and AMT-191 (Fabry disease) gene therapy programs in the first half of 2027, including completion of second-cohort enrollment for AMT-260 in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: uniQure is expected to report Q3 2026 financial results and provide further updates on the BLA/MAA filing progress, consistent with its usual quarterly reporting cadence.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision
catalysts.detail: If the BLA is accepted for accelerated approval review, a possible FDA approval decision on AMT-130 could arrive roughly a year or more after the Q3 2026 filing, positioning uniQure for a potential first Huntington's disease-modifying therapy launch.

pulse: uniQure has been re-rated sharply higher after the FDA reversed course and aligned with the company on using 3-year Phase I/II data (showing a statistically significant 75% slowing of Huntington's disease progression) as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA, which management now plans to file in Q3 2026 alongside a parallel UK MAA and an expected priority-review request. Q2 2026 results showed a wider-than-expected non-GAAP loss but a fortified balance sheet ($810.3 million in cash, runway into 2030 after a $259 million raise), and management says it is preparing for a likely FDA advisory committee meeting even as most Wall Street analysts have turned bullish, with price targets clustered in the $60-$80 range. The stock remains a high-conviction, high-volatility binary bet on AMT-130's regulatory and commercial fate, with the next major catalysts being the actual BLA/MAA filings, four-year follow-up data in September, and confirmatory-trial-design finalization later in 2026.
